## Context / Problem
The three provider overlays contain repeated or historical comments identified by the audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. Shortening them must preserve provider selection, cross-provider comparability, and credential isolation.

## Approach
Edit only standalone comments and blank lines in the declared TOML files. Preserve configuration values byte-for-byte and retain the minimum current rationale needed by external-test operators.

## Scope
- `anthropic.toml` — Preserve explicit config-file-path coverage, credential name, provider-qualified `[llm] model`, and all three model-class slots so ambient provider defaults cannot leak in.
- `bedrock.toml` — Preserve same-Claude-family cross-provider comparability; inference-profile-only IDs with nonuniform suffixes; verbatim AWS discovery; region and ambient-AWS credentials; provider-qualified scalar model plus every class slot; and matrix-only Anthropic-key blanking.
- `openai.toml` — Preserve best-effort support tier, credential, verified models, provider-qualified scalar model, and every class slot.

Consumers are `src/rebar/_config_sources.py` plus the LLM config/class resolver; `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml`; `.github/workflows/structured-output-baseline.yml`; `.github/workflows/jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml` for the Anthropic overlay; the `rebar.toml` and Compose Bedrock pins; and provider/config pin tests. Workflow prose is owned by `sphalerite-bereft-tortoise`; the stale provider README is tracked by `wearied-convincing-arrowana`.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only the permitted comments/docstrings or blank lines in the declared files; executable/configuration data and exact behavior-bearing directives remain unchanged.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked TSV semantic matrix authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row confirming that redundant, obvious, duplicated, stale, or historical prose was removed while current rationale remained.
- [ ] Recorded focused checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and repository lint pass at the leaf commit.
- [ ] Missing or FAIL semantic rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded content-only guards, focused checks, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint. The independent matrix, not exact prose matching, judges semantic preservation.
